en.headline: Saudel makes landfall in Fujian; Signal No. 1 stays today
en.dek: The Observatory said Tropical Storm Saudel had made landfall over Zhangzhou and at 8am was about 370 kilometres east-northeast of Hong Kong, with Signal No. 1 remaining in force.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal, No. 1 remained in force on Thursday morning after Tropical Storm Saudel made landfall over Zhangzhou in Fujian. In a bulletin issued at 7.45am, the Observatory estimated that at 8am Saudel was about 370 kilometres east-northeast of Hong Kong, near 23.8 degrees north and 117.4 degrees east.

The storm was forecast to be slow-moving at first, then move west at about 12 kilometres per hour across the vicinity of the eastern Guangdong coast. The Observatory said Saudel would later today track west across inland areas of eastern Guangdong and weaken gradually. It is expected to edge closer to the Pearl River Estuary on Friday, 4 September, though there are uncertainties over how much it will weaken by then.

Under the combined effect of Saudel and the northeast monsoon, local winds are occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. The Observatory said Signal No. 1 would remain in force today. Depending on Saudel's intensity when it is near the estuary, how close its associated strong winds come, and changes in local wind conditions, the Observatory will assess whether the Strong Wind Signal, No. 3 is needed.

The 8.45am local forecast called for sunny periods with a maximum of around 31 degrees and one or two showers later. Winds will be moderate to fresh northwesterly, occasionally strong offshore and on high ground, with swells. The Observatory advised people to stay away from the shoreline, skip water sports, and check windows, doors and outdoor fixtures.

zh.headline: 沙德爾登陸漳州 一號戒備信號今日維持
zh.dek: 天文台早上7時45分公布，熱帶風暴沙德爾已登陸福建漳州，上午8時位於本港東北偏東約370公里，一號戒備信號繼續生效。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號周四早上仍然生效，熱帶風暴沙德爾已登陸福建漳州。天文台於上午7時45分發出的熱帶氣旋警告中指出，上午8時沙德爾集結在本港東北偏東約370公里，即北緯23.8度、東經117.4度附近。
天文台預料沙德爾初時移動緩慢，其後向西移動，時速約12公里，橫過廣東東部沿岸一帶。按照現時預測，沙德爾稍後今日會西移進入廣東東部內陸並逐漸減弱，預料周五（9月4日）再度靠近珠江口一帶，但減弱幅度存在變數。
受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。天文台表示一號戒備信號今日維持。視乎沙德爾靠近珠江口時的強度、相關強風區距離珠江口遠近，以及本港風力變化，天文台會評估是否需要改發三號強風信號。
天文台上午8時45分的本地預報指，今日部分時間有陽光，最高氣溫約31度，稍後有一兩陣驟雨；吹和緩至清勁西北風，離岸及高地間中吹強風，並有湧浪。天文台呼籲市民遠離岸邊、避免水上活動，並檢查門窗及戶外設施。
